properties.name: management.observations.r2dbc.include-parameter-values
properties.description: Whether to tag actual query parameter values.

properties.name: spring.r2dbc.generate-unique-name
properties.description: Whether to generate a random database name. Ignore any configured name when enabled.

properties.name: spring.r2dbc.name
properties.description: Database name. Set if no name is specified in the url. Default to "testdb" when using an embedded database.

properties.name: spring.r2dbc.password
properties.description: Login password of the database. Set if no password is specified in the url.

properties.name: spring.r2dbc.pool.acquire-retry
properties.description: Number of acquire retries if the first acquire attempt fails.

properties.name: spring.r2dbc.pool.enabled
properties.description: Whether pooling is enabled. Requires r2dbc-pool.

properties.name: spring.r2dbc.pool.max-acquire-time
properties.description: Maximum time to acquire a connection from the pool. By default, wait indefinitely.

properties.name: spring.r2dbc.pool.max-create-connection-time
properties.description: Maximum time to wait to create a new connection. By default, wait indefinitely.

properties.name: spring.r2dbc.pool.max-idle-time
properties.description: Maximum amount of time that a connection is allowed to sit idle in the pool.

properties.name: spring.r2dbc.pool.max-life-time
properties.description: Maximum lifetime of a connection in the pool. By default, connections have an infinite lifetime.

properties.name: spring.r2dbc.pool.max-validation-time
properties.description: Maximum time to validate a connection from the pool. By default, wait indefinitely.

properties.name: spring.r2dbc.url
properties.description: R2DBC URL of the database. database name, username, password and pooling options specified in the url take precedence over individual options.

properties.name: spring.r2dbc.username
properties.description: Login username of the database. Set if no username is specified in the url.
